_comment: The 4 scheduled tasks. 'name' is the stable key passed as -TaskName. 'schedule' is consumed by tools/Register-ScheduledTasks.ps1. All tasks share the same Monarch session-assurance prep; they differ only in the Cowork prompt they launch.

tasks.name: Paycheck

schedule._comment: Run after payday posts. Adjust day/time to your pay cycle.

tasks.notes: Updates expected/actual paycheck amounts and recurring income in Monarch.

tasks.name: R1Transfer

schedule._comment: Runs shortly after Paycheck so balances reflect the new deposit.

tasks.notes: Reads current balances and computes the recommended transfer amount(s) for the R1 account.

tasks.name: TelegramCommission

schedule._comment: Daily because commission messages arrive throughout the week.

tasks.notes: Pulls commission figures (from Telegram) and records them in Monarch.

tasks.name: StudentLoan

schedule._comment: Weekly balance reconciliation for the student loan account.

tasks.notes: Updates the manual student loan balance in Monarch to match the servicer.
